title: ToolsPanel renders tools as a single column instead of the Flash 8 two-column grid
description: FIXED. Changed toolGrid gridTemplateColumns from repeat(1, 22px) to repeat(2, 22px) in packages/authoring-ui/src/ToolsPanel.tsx (line 325). The flattened TOOL_ROWS pairs (already authored 2-wide) now render left-to-right then down: Selection|Subselection / FreeTransform|GradientTransform / Lasso|Pen / Line|Text / Oval|Rect / PolyStar|Pencil / Brush|InkBottle / PaintBucket|Eyedropper / Eraser|Hand / Zoom(alone, bottom-left). Panel width metrics.toolsPanelWidth=67px unchanged (two 22px cells = 44px + 1px gap + 2px padding = 47px, fits). Also fixed stale 'single column' comment. 1262 button up/active/hover states (toolBtn/toolBtnHover/toolBtnActive) UNTOUCHED -- no regression.
